visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Under a light-colored wooden table, a brown tabby cat sits on a beige fabric office chair. A human hand briefly reaches out to pet the cat's back. The lighting is soft and warm. (2) A tricolor calico cat is partially hidden behind the backrest of a grey fabric sofa, peeking out with wide eyes toward the camera. (3) A tortoiseshell cat stands on a white bed, looking around with a curious and alert expression. (4) Two cats, one ginger and one white with grey patches, are huddled together under a table. The scene transitions to a ginger cat sitting on a round white table, looking out of a large window with green trees visible outside. (5) A white cat with a black patch on its head looks through a window screen into a bright, natural outdoor environment. (6) A ginger and white cat is tucked inside a white soft cloth bag, looking inquisitive. (7) A white cat with black spots stands on its hind legs on a wooden shelf, stretching its body while looking upward. (8) A close-up shot of the initial brown tabby cat resting its chin on a dark purple piece of clothing. (9) A ginger cat lying on a brown cardboard box yawns widely, displaying its teeth and tongue. (10) A white cat is nestled inside a grey knitted cat bed, yawning before looking over the edge at the camera.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Fact Delivery -> Practical Application -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate cat owners about their pets' auditory capabilities and behavioral responses. It explains the biological mechanism of cat ears and uses this to help owners distinguish between a cat that didn't hear a call and one that is intentionally ignoring them.
